title: Mediator Consultant - Saskatchewan for the Farm Debt Mediation Service (FDMS)
description: The Programs Branch (PB) of Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) has requirements on an "as and when requested" basis for professional resources with expertise and skillsets for the delivery of financial counselling and mediation services. This requirement is to establish a Task Authorization Contract with a qualified Contractor's for services in Saskatchewan. It is intended to result in the award of 5 (five) contracts for 5 (five) years. The Farm Debt Mediation Service (FDMS) offers free financial counselling and mediation services to farmers who are having difficulties meeting their financial obligations. It is a voluntary, private and confidential service that brings farmers and their creditors together with a Mediator in a neutral forum to reach a mutually acceptable solution. The FDMS Administrator will assign a Financial Consultant and a Mediator to work with the farmer through the mediation process. Confidentiality is extremely important to the quality and effectiveness of the service. Information obtained from the farmer and their creditor(s) is used for the sole purpose of mediation and is shared only among the parties involved in the mediation process. The Mediator will facilitate communication between the farmer and their creditor(s), guide them through the mediation process, and remain neutral throughout. The Mediator will work collaboratively with the Financial Consultant to understand the context of the file, including the recovery plan developed by the farmer and the Financial Consultant. title: Montenegro – Radiotherapy devices and supplies – Supply of HDR Brachytherapy System within LIFEGATE project
description: Cardiovascular and oncological diseases remain the leading causes of morbidity and mortality in Montenegro and the wider cross-border region. According to GLOBOCAN 2020 data, Montenegro recorded 3,184 new cancer cases and 1,765 cancer-related deaths. With the expected increase in cancer incidence, an ageing population, and existing healthcare challenges, improving early detection, diagnostics, and access to specialised treatment is becoming increasingly important. The Clinical Centre of Montenegro (CCM), as the country's leading tertiary healthcare institution, plays a crucial role in providing specialised oncology services. Through this project, CCM aims to strengthen its diagnostic and treatment capacities, introduce advanced medical technologies, and improve the quality and accessibility of cancer care. A particular focus is placed on early lung cancer detection and the improvement of radiotherapy treatment, including the application of advanced techniques such as stereotactic radiotherapy and brachytherapy. These approaches are expected to contribute to more precise and effective treatment, improved patient outcomes, and better survival rates. Brachytherapy represents an important component of the planned improvements at CCM, offering opportunities to enhance treatment efficiency and quality for patients with various malignancies, particularly cervical, prostate, oesophageal, and lung cancers. The project will also support the development of innovative digital solutions, improved cancer prevention and screening programmes, and the modernisation of healthcare infrastructure through new equipment and professional training. Through cooperation with healthcare institutions in Croatia and Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Clinical Centre of Montenegro will contribute to strengthening cross-border collaboration, exchanging medical expertise, and promoting common standards in cancer prevention, diagnosis, and treatment. Ultimately, the project aims to improve access to modern oncology services, enhance treatment outcomes, and strengthen the long-term capacities of the Clinical Centre of Montenegro, benefiting patients in Montenegro and the wider cross-border region.

title: Borough of Millvale, Pennsylvania, Local Protection Project (LPP) PL84-99 Rehabilitation
description: The Millvale LPP was constructed by U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) in 1980 under the authority of Section 205 of the Flood Control Act of 1948 as amended. The project consists of about 6,200 feet of channel improvement including concrete gravity retaining walls, concrete wall supports, anchored concrete toe blocks, concrete cap walls, stone-filled gabion mattresses, flap gates and access ramps. The LPP is an urban Flood Control Work (FCW), and it is not a multipurpose project. Heavy rains from 1-12 April 2024 caused flooding which damaged the Project within Girtys Run, including bank erosion, shoaling, erosion of the improved channel, ruptured gabion baskets, washed-out concrete buttresses, and erosion of grouted riprap. Of particular concern are the washed-out buttresses which have migrated to the center of the improved channel, impeding streamflow. If the buttresses are not removed and stream bank improvements continue to deteriorate, there is a risk that debris will continue to accumulate and could ultimately damage the channel downstream of the impediment. To address these damages, Allegheny County requested rehabilitation assistance from USACE through the PL 84-99 program, which authorizes USACE to rehabilitate eligible Federal and non-Federal LPPs damaged or destroyed by floods. An agreement was signed on 6 August 2025 between the Borough of Millvale and USACE to complete the necessary repairs. The work is to be completed within 365 calendar days after written Notice to Proceed (NTP). The Anticipated Construction Cost is between $300,000.00 and $350,000.00. The North American Industrial Classification Code (NAICS) is 237990 - Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. The Small Business Size Standard is $45,000,000.00. Any resultant award will be for one (1) Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Purchase Order. The anticipated award date is 22 December 2026. The basis of award will be of best value to the Government. Quotes will be evaluated in accordance with (IAW) RFO Part 13 and 36, price and past performance. The Government reserves the right to reject any quotes that exceed available funds for this requirement. Information regarding the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers process for settling requests for equitable adjustments and duration goals to achieve definitization of equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts can be found by going to https://www.usace.army.mil/Strategic-Partnerships/Partnering/mod/129895/details/443/ then scrolling down on right hand side of page by clicking on View FFP Contract Changes Playbook Here.

title: STEC Media
description: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service is part of a science-based national system to ensure food safety and food defense. FSIS ensures food safety through the authorities of the Federal Meat Inspection Act, the Poultry Products Inspection Act, and the Egg Products Inspection Act, as well as humane animal handling through the Humane Methods of Slaughter Act. As such this RFI seeks to gather information on commercially available STEC colony isolation procedures that increase the likelihood of identifying and isolating a variety of STEC in raw beef or other food products, regardless of serogroup, from a mixed population. FSIS seeks to understand the level of granularity in STEC confirmation protocols, including selective media that do not rely on STEC serogroup. Please review the attached documents for more information.

description: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) Johnson Space Center (JSC) is issuing a Final Request for Proposal (RFP) for the Commercial Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Destination Contract (CLDC), 80JSC027R0004. Offerors are encouraged to submit questions as soon as possible for consideration. Questions shall be submitted using the Template for Submission of Comments in the �Attachments� section below. Telephone questions will not be accepted. The RFP and attachments have been posted in the "Attachments" section below. This RFP and associated documents supersede the Draft RFP in its entirety. Any additional documents will be available on www.sam.gov. The Technical Library is available on www.sam.gov under notice ID 80JSC025_CLDC_TECH_LIBRARY. The Pre-Proposal Conference for this solicitation is anticipated to be held (virtual only) via Microsoft Teams on Thursday, October 15, 2026, starting at 1:00 p.m. Central Time. Attendance at the pre-proposal conference is recommended; however, attendance is neither required nor a prerequisite for proposal submission. No recordings or use of Super Intelligence (SI) note-taking capabilities of any kind are permitted. Participation is limited to a total of ten (10) individuals from each company/team. title: Repair Aids to Navigation (ATON) - Southern Area of USCG District Northeast
description: Contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, transportation, supervision and disposal required for the structural repair, recapitalization, and/or demolish Aids to Navigation (ATON) structures at various southern sites in the CG Northeast District. The project consists of a Base Bid at the following sites in New York, Connecticut and Rhode Island: 1. New Haven Middle Breakwater West End Light (LLNR 24070): Replace existing tower in kind. 2. Stonington Outer Breakwater Light 4 (LLNR 20170): Replace existing concrete foundation, replace existing tower with standard 5x5 tower. 3. Stonington Breakwater Light 5 (LLNR 20175): Replace existing concrete foundation, repoint existing granite block foundation, replace existing tower in kind. 4. Norwalk Channel Light 10 (LLNR 24990): Replace existing foundation and tower in kind. 5. Port Jefferson West Breakwater Light 2A (LLNR 26145): Replace existing foundation and tower in kind. 6. Connecticut River Light 135 (LLNR 23300): Demolish ATON structure to below-grade elevation & reseed. 7. Point Judith Harbor of Refuge West Entrance Light 3 (LLNR 19505):Demolish existing structure & rebuild as standard 5x5 tower on concrete foundation offset from jetty erosion. An option item for an additional Aid to Navigation (ATON) structure repair in Massachusetts is included as follows: 1. Chatham Light (LLNR 525): Replace windows in kind & clean/recoat exterior/interior. The estimated value of the procurement is between $1,000,000 and $5,000,000. A 20% bid guarantee is required. Performance and Payment bonds will be required. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 237990 - Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction with a small business size standard of $45.0 million. Solicitation packages will be available on or about 4 November 2026. The tentative date set for receipt of bids is 8 December 2026 at 2:00 p.m. The base performance period is estimated to be 300 calendar days from issuance of Notice to Proceed and the option performance period is estimated to be 60 calendar days to be exercised at the Contracting Officers discretion. This acquisition is issued pursuant to FAR Part 14 Sealed Bidding and is 100% Set-Aside for Small Business concerns. All relevant solicitation documents, including specifications and drawings may be accessed for download beginning on the date of issue of the IFB at the following site: https://www.sam.gov. Vendors MUST be registered in the System for Award Management database through https://www.sam.gov in order to receive a federal government contract. THE GOVERNMENT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CANCEL THIS SOLICITATION EITHER BEFORE OR AFTER THE CLOSING DATE. NO REIMBURSEMENT WILL BE MADE FOR ANY COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH PROVIDING INFORMATION IN RESPONSE TO THIS PRESOLICITATION NOTICE OR ANY FOLLOW-UP INFORMATION REQUEST.

title: 2027 NIAID DMID Omnibus Broad Agency Announcement: Development of Medical Interventions for Infectious Diseases
description: INTRODUCTION: The National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID), one of 27 institutes of the NIH, an agency within the Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS); conducts and supports research to understand, treat, and ultimately prevent the myriad infectious, immunologic, and allergic diseases that threaten the health and longevity of human lives.Through a variety of research grants and contracts, NIAID�s Division of Microbiology and Infectious Diseases (DMID) specifically supports extramural research to develop new medical interventions against infectious disease threats to include drug-resistant pathogens. NIAID/DMID intends to use this BAA to help address goals articulated in a number of strategic plans, such as in the Public Health Emergency Medical Countermeasures Enterprise Strategy and Implementation Plan (https://aspr.hhs.gov/PHEMCE/2024-PHEMCE-SIP/Pages/default.aspx), as well as current prioritized antimicrobial resistant threats identified by national death and infection estimates as determined by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention�s (CDC) to prevent and control antimicrobial resistance (https://www.cdc.gov/antimicrobial-resistance/data-research/threats/index.html). In addition, NIAID/DMID intends to use this BAA to encourage projects that align with the NIH priorities of enhancing rigor & reproducibility, improving biosafety and biosecurity, and the use of complementary non-animal testing methods where appropriate. This Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) is soliciting proposals to advance the research and development of promising candidate therapeutics, vaccines, and diagnostics for infectious diseases in each of three (3) Research Areas described below and more thoroughly discussed in the attached BAA Solicitation. An offeror should carefully review the content of the BAA Solicitation No. HHS-NIH-NIAID-BAA2026-1 for the comprehensive information regarding all requirements, the technical objective of each Research Area of this BAA Solicitation, instructions regarding the proposal submission, and a description of the evaluation and award process. Please note, due to the competitive nature of the BAA Solicitation, the NIAID is unable to offer advice or feedback regarding an offeror�s specific technical approach. Offerors should exercise their professional judgment when compiling their proposals in line with the requirements and specifications of the BAA Solicitation. Research Area 001 - Vaccine Candidates: The objective is to develop vaccine candidates through an early phase clinical trial that use a needle free (i.e., alternative to classical needle and syringe, see below for description) route of delivery to protect against infections caused by viral pathogens that include but are not limited to respiratory and vector borne viruses. The scope of this vaccine research area includes the preclinical development of a needle free vaccine candidate, IND enabling studies, limited process development, Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) compliant manufacturing, regulatory submissions to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and conduct of a Phase 1 or early Phase 2 clinical trial. The scope of work must include a clinical trial. Offerors must propose a single vaccine candidate for protection against a specific viral pathogen. The vaccine candidate may provide a breadth of protection against other viral strains or viruses. A strong justification is required to support (1) the proposed vaccine antigen and platform for the disease indication, (2) the use of a clinically relevant adjuvant (if needed), and (3) a clinically relevant needle free route of delivery. Research Area 002 - Therapeutic Candidates: The objective is to develop safe, effective, new therapeutic products that will improve patient outcomes against serious infectious diseases for which there are no approved therapeutics, or for those that are refractory to treatment despite appropriate antimicrobial therapy or due to pathogen resistance. Infectious diseases caused by the following viruses, bacteria and fungi pathogens are targeted: Viral hemorrhagic fever viruses (e.g., EBOV, SUDV, MARV, LASV, hantavirus) https://www.cdc.gov/viral-hemorrhagic-fevers/about/index.html Encephalitic paramyxoviruses (e.g. hendra virus, nipah virus) Picornaviruses (broad spectrum approaches that include EV68, EV70 and coxsackie virus) At least two of the following (i.e., addressed with a broad spectrum antimicrobial): susceptible and carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae (CRE), susceptible and multidrug resistant (MDR) Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and susceptible and Carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter (CRAB), with potential to improve patient outcomes in the clinic; Candida auris, Cryptococcus spp., Aspergillus fumigatus, and/or Mucorales Adjunct medical interventions to support or enhance effectiveness of antimicrobial agents to address underlying pathology that is not resolved after clearance of pathogens, may be considered. Important notice to Offerors: For this Research Area, �therapeutic� activity means curing disease by eliminating or substantially reducing infective pathogens by administering antimicrobial pharmaceutical agents, with or without a host-directed therapy. Additionally, proposed therapeutic products should consider the impact on a healthy microbiome. Preventative treatments are not included in the scope of this Research Area. A therapeutic candidate refers to an advanced lead series, preclinical candidates, or a clinical candidate, that is a new chemical entity. This includes small molecules, natural products, nucleosides, or peptides of </= 40 amino acids, monoclonal antibodies, nanobodies, nanobody conjugate/fusion products, microbiome-based therapeutics or bacteriophages. Research Area 002 will support lead optimization, pre-clinical Investigational New Drug (IND) enabling studies, and Phase 1 clinical trials (or proof of concept Phase 2 clinical trials) of lead candidates with demonstrated therapeutic activities. This includes support for traditional, novel (e.g., small molecules) and non-traditional (e.g., including but not limited to phage, and host-directed) therapeutics for infectious diseases where patients lack effective interventions, as well as therapeutics that promote host-mediated resolution of disease. The scope of support differs depending on the developmental stage of the project being proposed, which is further discussed in the BAA Solicitation. Research Area 003 - In Vitro Diagnostics The objective of Research Area 003 is to develop innovative, technology platforms that will speed detection and identification of infectious viruses covering a broad panel of virus families, including viruses causing acute infections as well as those causing chronic infections. Technology platform innovation to achieve faster actionable sequencing results (approaching 2 hr) direct from primary clinical specimens, as well as more accessible workflow and configuration (i.e., point-of-care) are preferred. Furthermore, full sample-to-answer platform solutions are preferred. The system should accept specimen volumes from 0.5 to 5 milliliters (mL). The system should include nearly full automation (little or no hands-on activity after specimen has been loaded into system). Sample preparation components of the system should yield sufficient analyte recovery from a starting titer of 10-100 genomic copies per mL of biofluid for downstream analysis, including detection, identification, and characterization of the nucleic acid material. Innovations during platform development might include, for example: Automated sample prep for high recovery from low pathogen load. Faster specimen-to-answer for total test time <2 hours. Broad viral pathogen detection capability, covering one or more members of the priority pathogen families (see below). title: Preventive Maintenance and Repair Services - Kahuku Training Area (KTA)
description: The Regional Contracting Office Hawaii (RCO-HI) has a requirement for preventive maintenance, inspection, testing, unscheduled assessment/trouble-call, and repair services for HVAC; fire alarm and mass notification; emergency lighting and exit signs; and lightning protection systems at Kahuku Training Area, Oahu, Hawaii. The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, tools, materials, transportation, supervision, and other resources necessary to perform the requirement in accordance with the solicitation and Performance Work Statement. This solicitation is issued as Request for Quotations (RFQ) No. W912CN27QA008 and is a 100 percent Total Small Business Set-Aside under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 561210. The Government contemplates award of one firm-fixed-price requirements contract consisting of a base period and four 12-month option periods, with evaluation of the six-month option to extend services under FAR 52.217-8. The solicitation is conducted under the provisions of Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. To be eligible for award, quoters must maintain an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM), including current and complete representations and certifications, at the time of quote submission and at the time of award. Quoters are responsible for monitoring SAM.gov for amendments and other solicitation information through the closing date. Refer to Section L, pages 113�116, for quote-submission instructions and required submission content, and Section M, pages 120�121, for evaluation criteria. Quoters must submit all required documents, including the signed SF 1449 and acknowledgement of all amendments, completed pricing documents for all applicable priced CLINs, and the technical capability submission. Do not price Repair Services CLIN 0006 or its option-year counterparts; repair services will be ordered and priced after award through Contracting Officer-issued firm-fixed-price task orders. Written questions are due no later than 10:00 a.m. Hawaii Standard Time (HST), Thursday, 19 November 2026. Questions shall be submitted to both: Travis Tonini, Contract Specialist: travis.c.tonini.civ@army.mil Keely K. Pool, Contracting Officer: keely.k.pool.civ@army.mil Completed quotations and all supporting documentation must be submitted electronically by email to Travis Tonini at travis.c.tonini.civ@army.mil no later than 10:00 a.m. HST, Tuesday, 8 December 2026. Faxed quotations will not be accepted. A site visit at Kahuku Training Area is scheduled for Tuesday, 17 November 2026. Attendance is strongly encouraged but not mandatory. Offerors intending to attend must submit required visit-request information no later than 12:00 p.m. HST, Tuesday, 10 November 2026, to Travis Tonini for further instructions. (Solit file states 10:00 AM, but 12:00 p.m. is the official cut off).

title: ERDC Watercraft and Ship Simulator Support Services Multiple Award Task Order Contract
description: This is an unrestricted, full and open, Request for Proposal for the establishment of a Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC).The ordering period will consist of a 24-month base period and three 12-month option periods, for a total potential ordering period of 60 months, if all options are exercised. The overall objective of this procurement is to augment ERDCs ship simulation capabilities by acquiring specialized, independent maritime simulation and engineering support services to deliver technically rigorous, time-sensitive simulation solutions to USACE navigation challenges. The Contractor shall independently execute designated simulation tasks, conduct technical analyses, and deliver finalized engineering reports as specified in individual Task Orders, leveraging external maritime expertise to support the USACE navigation mission. Navigation study services not directly connected with project maintenance and operations are considered commercial activities and not inherently governmental. (33 U.S.C. 2321(b)).

title: Electron Storage Ring D2 Dipole Magnets
description: Brookhaven Science Associates, LLC (BSA), under a Prime Contract for the operation of Brookhaven National Laboratory (BNL) with the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), herewith solicits your proposal for 195 EIC ESR D2 Dipole Magnets (194 production magnets and 1 first article magnet). The scope of this acquisition comprises of the detailed magnet engineering design and production of Electron Storage Ring (ESR) D2 Dipole Magnets for the Electron-Ion Collider (EIC). The magnets are an integral part of the process to create intense beams of relativistic energy electrons and ions in opposing particle storage rings that will be brought into collision in a large experimental detector. This will provide insight into the internal structure of protons and neutrons and the gluelike force that holds them together. The Offeror shall furnish all labor, services, materials and equipment in accordance with the draft contract, Enclosure 1, including the Statement of Work and referenced Specifications and Drawings. Please submit your proposal by 5:00PM EST on December 8, 2026. All questions must be submitted in writing via e-mail; replies to questions will be provided in writing and, if considered to be of general interest, will be transmitted to all other offerors. If for any reason you are unable to submit a proposal, kindly reply in writing and return this letter with all of the attachments. The tender for geothermal boreholes covers the installation of the geothermal probe system for Building 07B at St. Gallen Cantonal Hospital. The scope of work includes site establishment, drilling operations, and the supply, installation, and complete backfilling of the geothermal probes in accordance with the tender documents.

The interface with the building-side heating system is defined by the handover points specified in the tender documents. All works must be coordinated with the contractors involved and the construction management team.

title: Germany – Architectural, engineering and planning services – JG | U Ersatzneubauten Gewächshäuser - Generalplanervergabe
description: Für die Baumaßnahme "Ersatzneubauten Gewächshäuser" in Mainz werden Generalplanerleistungen für die abschnittsweise Umsetzung des Vorhabens vergeben. Gegenstand sind der Rückbau der be-stehenden Gewächshausanlagen sowie die Planung und Realisierung der Ersatzneubauten ein-schließlich der zugehörigen Freianlagen und der Einbindung in das Gesamtareal des Botanischen Gartens. Der Generalplaner übernimmt die übergeordnete Koordination, Integration und Schnittstellenbear-beitung der beauftragten Objekt- und Fachplanungen sowie die Einbindung der vom Auftraggeber gesondert beauftragten Fachbeteiligten. Die Planung erfolgt bis zur ausführungsreifen und vergabe-fähigen Planung einschließlich Leistungsbeschreibungen und Leistungsverzeichnissen. Seitens des Auftraggebers wird eine gebündelte Vergabe wesentlicher Bauleistungen an einen Generalunter-nehmer favorisiert. Besonders zu berücksichtigen sind der laufende Pflanzen-, Forschungs- und Gar-tenbetrieb sowie die abschnittsweise und teilweise überlappende Umsetzung der Bauabschnitte. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere: - Objektplanung Gebäude und Innenräume: Grundleistungen der LPH 2 bis 9 sowie die projektspezifischen Besonderen Leistungen gem. Teil 3 Abschnitt 1 HOAI. - Tragwerksplanung: Grundleistungen der LPH 1 bis 6 sowie ergänzende Besondere Leistungen für Vergabe, Ausführung, ingenieurtechnische Kontrolle, Dokumentation und Objektbetreuung gem. Teil 4 Abschnitt 1 HOAI. - Thermische Bauphysik / Wärmeschutz / Energiebilanzierung: Grundleistungen der LPH 1 bis 7 nach Anlage 1 Nr. 1.2 HOAI sowie die projektspezifischen Besonderen Leistungen, insbesondere zu Wärme-, Feuchte-, Kondensat- und Wärmebrückenschutz sowie zu den Schnittstellen der Gewächshaushülle zur TGA. - Freianlagenplanung: Grundleistungen der LPH 2 bis 9 sowie die projektspezifischen Besonderen Leistungen einschließlich Erschließung, Vegetation, Bauabschnitts- und Interimszuständen sowie Schnittstellen zu Regenwasserbewirtschaftung, technischen Außenanlagen und Entwässerung gem. Teil 3 Abschnitt 2 i.V.m. Anlage 11 HOAI. - Technische Ausrüstung gem. Teil 4 Abschnitt 2 HOAI: Leistungen nach Maßgabe der jeweiligen spezifischen Leistungspflichten für - Anlagengruppen 1 bis 3 und 7, insbesondere gewächshausspezifische Klima-, Heizungs-, Lüf-tungs-, Bewässerungs-, Vernebelungs-, Verschattungs- und Energieschirmtechnik, - Anlagengruppen 4 und 5, insbesondere elektrotechnische sowie kommunikations- und infor-mationstechnische Anlagen, und - Anlagengruppe 8, Gebäudeautomation/Gebäudeleittechnik einschließlich Regelungs-, Steue-rungs-, Monitoring- und Schnittstellenfunktionen. Ergänzend sind Leistungen des bauordnungsrechtlichen Brandschutzes in Anlehnung an AHO-Heft Nr. 17, der Nachhaltigkeitskoordination / BNB gemäß projektspezifischer Zielvereinbarung sowie des Schadstoffmanagements, des selektiven Rückbaus, der Entsorgungs- und Materialstromplanung und des zirkulären Bauens gemäß den jeweiligen spezifischen Leistungspflichten zu erbringen. Die Leistungen werden entsprechend den dort festgelegten Leistungsstufen 1 bis 5 erbracht. Die Fachplanung Brandschutz orientiert sich an den Leistungsstufen des AHO-Heftes Nr. 17. Die Leistungen BNB/Nachhaltigkeitskoordination sowie Schadstoffe / zirkuläres Bauen werden projekt-spezifisch in Leistungsstufen 1 bis 5 gegliedert. Soweit einzelne Leistungen Leistungsphasen der HOAI zugeordnet sind, ergibt sich die jeweilige Zuordnung aus den spezifischen Leistungspflichten. Die Leistungen "Kunst am Bau" werden gesondert betrachtet. Die daraus resultierenden planeri-schen, baulichen, technischen und terminlichen Schnittstellen sind durch den Generalplaner in die Gesamtplanung und den Bauablauf zu integrieren; die fachlich-künstlerische Bewertung ist nicht Be-standteil der Generalplanerleistung. Vom Auftraggeber gesondert beauftragte bzw. bereitgestellte Leistungen - insbesondere Bau-grund/Geotechnik, Vermessung, SiGeKo, Ingenieur für kontaminierte Bereiche, übergeordnete brandschutztechnische Beratung/Prüfung, Prüfstatik, Kanal-/Leitungs- und Spartenuntersuchungen sowie Kampfmitteluntersuchungen - sind hinsichtlich ihrer für die Gesamtplanung relevanten Ergeb-nisse durch den Generalplaner zu integrieren. Die fachliche Verantwortung verbleibt bei den jeweili-gen Leistungserbringern.

title: Germany – Hospital facilities construction work – 111 Einrichtung für AEMP
description: Das Städtische Klinikum Kiel (SKK) soll im Zuge des Neubauvorhabens eine neue AEMP und eine neue Endoskopieaufbereitung erhalten. Beide Bereiche befinden sich im Sockelgeschoss des Haus 6. Ziel ist es ein gutes Gesamtkonzept für die Sterilgutaufbereitung zu implementieren. Der Leistungsumfang dieser Ausschreibung sieht die Lieferung, Montage und Inbetriebnahme folgender Geräte vor: Los 1: - 4 Dampfsterilisatoren (8StE, 9 StE oder 10 StE) it Entladesystem und mit 2 Elektrodampferzeugern - Trennwandelement mit Rückgabefenster (reiner /steriler Bereich) - Beschickungswagen -Wartung und Validierung Los2: - 2 große CWAs in der AEMP - 1 kleinere CWA in der Endoskopieaufbereitung, aufgrund der Raumgröße darf diese CWA nicht größer als 250x205cm (BxT) sein. - 5 bis 6 Durchreiche RDGs für die AEMP(die Ausschreibung ist hier bewusst konzeptionell offen gestaltet.) mit Durchreichefenster/Rückgabeschleuse - Automatisierungssystem im unreinen und im reinen Bereich (z.B. Rollenbahn, Roboter etc.) - 2 Durchreiche RDGs für die Aufbereitung von OP-Schuhen im 2.OG - 1 Zentrale Dosieranlage im Kellergeschoss mit Leitungen bis ins Sockelgeschoss. - Wartung und Validierung - Zubehörwagen Zu beachten ist, dass die Raumhöhe im Sockelgeschoss stark begrenzt ist. Die Raumhöhe (LRH) beträgt 2,35m und die Rohdeckenhöhe 3,06m. Es befindet sich eine hohe Installationsdichte der TGA in der Zwischendecke. Dadurch stehen im Deckenbereich nur ca. 10cm Deckenaufbau für die Installation zur Verfügung. Angestrebt wird ein mehrstufiges Verfahren. Im Teilnahmewettbewerb wird die allgemeine Eignung des Bieters geprüft und in der 2.Auswahlstufe des Teilnahmewettbewerbs wird eine losweise Eignung geprüft. Nach Durchlauf dieser Auswahlstufe wird pro Los die Bewerberzahl auf max. 3 Bieter reduziert (Bei gleicher Punktzahl entscheidet das Los). Die 3 Bieter aus Los 1 und die 3 Bieter aus Los 2 werden dann zur Angebotsabgabe aufgefordert. Nach der Angebotsphase folgen Verhandlungsgespräche mit den jeweiligen Bietern, die daraufhin die Möglichkeit haben, ein finales Angebot einzureichen.

title: Netherlands – Tree pruning – Bomenonderhoud, gemeente Voorst-2026
description: De gemeente Voorst is op zoek naar een professionele en betrouwbare partner voor het onderhoud van haar gemeentelijke bomenbestand. Via een openbare Europese aanbestedingsprocedure wordt een raamovereenkomst gesloten voor het uitvoeren van boomonderhoud en aanverwante werkzaamheden binnen de gemeente Voorst. De werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit begeleidings- en onderhoudssnoei, het realiseren van vrije doorgangsprofielen, het vellen van bomen, het frezen van stobben, calamiteitenwerkzaamheden, de bestrijding van eikenprocessierups en diverse boomtechnische werkzaamheden. Ook de registratie en verwerking van uitgevoerde werkzaamheden in GeoVisia maken onderdeel uit van de opdracht. De beoogde ingangsdatum van de raamovereenkomst is 1 maart 2027 en heeft een initiële looptijd van twee jaar, tot en met 28 februari 2029. De gemeente kan de overeenkomst vervolgens tweemaal met één jaar verlengen, waardoor de maximale looptijd vier jaar bedraagt, tot uiterlijk 28 februari 2031. De opdracht wordt gegund op basis van de laagste prijs.

title: TIDAL: Target-Induced Droplet Assembly of Ligands
description: Developed by Los Alamos National Laboratory, TIDAL (Target-Induced Droplet Assembly of Ligands) transforms the small antibody fragments known as nanobodies into a programmable, protein-only material that organizes itself on demand. By harnessing a natural process called liquid-liquid phase separation, TIDAL lets these binders gather into dense, dynamic droplets precisely when they encounter their intended target, giving developers a single platform that can purify proteins without costly resins, deliver drugs as a self-forming slow-release depot and even trap harmful proteins inside living cells. The outcome is a versatile toolkit that lowers production costs, simplifies manufacturing and opens fresh therapeutic and diagnostic possibilities, all from a building block that biology already knows how to make. Overview At the heart of TIDAL is a small, engineered tag, called an encapsulation peptide (EP), that is fused to a nanobody. When many of these tagged nanobodies are present, they undergo liquid-liquid phase separation, similar to what makes oil bead up in water, and they collect into concentrated liquid droplets made entirely of protein. Binding to the target molecule intensifies the effect, so the droplets form most strongly exactly where and when that target is present. Because the assembly is dynamic and reversible, the droplets behave as stimuli-responsive materials whose thickness and flow can be tuned by the target ligand, allowing one design to serve as a purification handle, a delivery vehicle or an intracellular trap. Technology Description TIDAL: Target-Induced Droplet Assembly of Ligands treats the nanobody itself as a structural component rather than merely a binding reagent. Each fusion polypeptide pairs a target-specific nanobody with the encapsulation peptide (EP), and it is the peptide that drives the many weak, cooperative interactions responsible for phase separation. In solution these interactions produce biomolecular condensates, dense droplet phases that concentrate the nanobodies far above their ordinary levels; the presence of the matching ligand pushes the balance further toward condensation. Because condensation is governed by many cooperative contacts rather than a single rigid bond, the droplets stay liquid-like and dynamic, and their formation can be reversed when the trigger is removed. Building on that behavior, the droplets function as programmable modules for delivery, stability or signal enhancement. Their rheology, meaning how readily they flow, can be switched by the target ligand, so a preparation can remain fluid enough to pass through a fine needle yet convert into a slow-release depot once injected. The same concentrating power lets the droplets scavenge and enrich internalized components to levels far above normal, which sharpens detection in diagnostics, and, when produced inside cells, the condensates can sequester disease-driving proteins such as oncogenic or viral factors into synthetic granules that block their activity. Purification follows the same logic: Triggering condensation precipitates the bound target out of solution, offering a resin-free alternative to the slow and expensive column methods used today. Advantages Cuts protein purification costs by replacing slow, expensive column resins with a simple trigger-and-precipitate step Enables patient-friendly, at-home injections that stay liquid in the syringe then set into a slow-release depot Works entirely from protein, avoiding synthetic carriers and easing manufacturing Can operate inside living cells to trap and neutralize harmful proteins linked to cancer or viral infection Boosts diagnostic sensitivity by concentrating faint signals into detectable droplets Offers one adaptable platform spanning manufacturing, therapy and detection Market Applications � Biopharmaceutical Manufacturing (antibody and enzyme purification, protein production) � Therapeutics and Drug Delivery (subcutaneous slow-release treatments, intracellular protein targeting) � Diagnostics (high-sensitivity detection assays, point-of-care testing) � Biotechnology (resin-free enzyme immobilization, biocatalysis) � Reagents (protein capture, condensate-based cell studies) TRL 3 U.S. Patent pending LA-UR-26-27937 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: M-Resistor
description: M-Resistor, developed by Los Alamos National Laboratory, offers pulsed power operators a more protective and more inspectable way to manage reflected energy in high-voltage systems. Unlike prior resistor designs that could fail internally without obvious signs and could return damaging energy to the power supply, M-Resistor adds an adjustable spark-gap path to isolated ground, improving protection across different voltage conditions while also giving personnel a clear visual view of the internal assembly and adjustment process. That combination supports longer equipment life, lower risk of surprise failures and greater operator confidence in demanding test and research environments. How it Works M-Resistor works by serving as a charge resistor for a MARX generator while also providing a controlled path for unwanted reflected energy. During normal operation, low-voltage current can charge the system, but if a reflected pulse occurs, the adjustable spark switch can divert that energy to an isolated ground instead of allowing it to travel back into the power supply. The adjustable gap lets the operator match the setting to the voltage being used, and the clear epoxy housing allows direct visual inspection of the internal condition and spark switch position. Technical Description M-Resistor is an improved resistor assembly derived from an earlier X-ray charge resistor architecture, but modified to address inspection, grounding and reflected-energy protection limitations identified in prior use. The M-Resistor design replaces a steel enclosure with a dense plastic case and uses clear epoxy potting so internal components remain visible for inspection. A central feature is the inclusion of an adjustable spark switch, or spark air gap, that can be set by a worker according to the voltage used to energize the system. That adjustability adds operating flexibility, missing from prior products. M-Resistor is intended for MARX-generated pulsed power technology and is designed to route reflected electrical pulses to a secondary isolated ground rather than back to the power supply or through the coaxial cable ground conductor. Advantages � Helps protect power supplies from damaging reflected energy � Adds an adjustable response for different operating voltages � Improves worker visibility during setup and inspection � Makes internal damage easier to detect because of clear epoxy potting � Uses an isolated ground path to improve system safety � Fits pulsed power environments that need a practical fail-safe layer Market Applications � Pulsed Power Systems (research platforms, test systems, laboratory pulse generation) � Instrumentation (charging systems, protective interfaces, power conditioning assemblies) � Defense (pulsed X-ray systems, evaluation platforms, hardened test assets) � Industrial Electronics (specialty power equipment, high-voltage integration packages, reliability upgrades) � Scientific Research Infrastructure (physics laboratories, experimental facilities, university-scale pulsed power setups) Development Status: TRL 4 US Patent pending LA-UR-26-24306 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. Die gegenständlichen Maßnahmen beinhalten sowohl der ein- und zweigleisigen Streckenabschnitte der Anbindungen an die Bestandsinfrastruktur der DB InfraGO AG, als auch alle hierfür durch den AN zu erbringenden bauvorbereitenden Zusammenhangsarbeiten (z.B. technische Bearbeitung, Leitungsumlegungs-/sicherungsmaßnahmen, Gründungsarbeiten, Einbau Weichen und Weichenheizungsanlagen, Kabeltiefbauarbeiten und -verlegung, Kampfmittelsondierungsleistungen, Sicherungsleistungen etc.). description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je zejména kompletní rekonstrukce silnoproudé a slaboproudé elektroinstalace v celém objektu (výměna rozvaděčů v jednotlivých patrech objektu, realizace nových rozvodů NN a rozvodů osvětlení a zásuvek, datových zásuvek, svítidel, podružných rozvaděčů v kancelářích, rozvaděče v rozvodně). Dále bude předmětem zakázky zajištění vedení kabelů k fotovoltaickým panelům v zazdívce sloupu nebo v nice rozvaděčů, provedení vnitřních omítek vč. zapravení po elektroinstalaci, nátěr zárubní a dodávka a montáž dveří včetně kování, jakož i demontáž podlahových krytin, provedení nivelačních stěrek podlah ve společných prostorách objektu, opravy nesoudržných betonových mazanin, provedení povrchových úprav či provedení výmaleb. Rovněž dojde k demontáži a zpětné montáži litinových otopných těles vč. nátěru a dodávce a montáži termohlavic, odstranění stávajících 2 ks plynových kotlů, dodávce plynového kondenzačního kotle o výkonu 49,9 kW a elektrokotle 18 kW vč. nových rozvodů plynu a zhotovení komínového tělesa. Současně dojde k doteplení střešního pláště, montáži fóliové krytiny s kamenným vsypem, zhotovení nových vnějších svodů a oplechování atiky tak, aby na střechu objektu byla instalována FVE s „chytrým řízením výkonu“ 48 kWp a bateriovým úložištěm 48 V. Předmětem zakázky je rovněž poskytování servisní podpory FVE, jejíž rozsah je uveden v návrhu Příkazní smlouvy.

title: Czechia – Urban planning and landscape architectural services – Změna č. 7 Územního plánu statutárního města Zlína
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je zpracování změny č. 7 Územního plánu statutárního města Zlína, jakožto jednoho z prvků plnění Strategie prostorového rozvoje města – Zlín 100 (dále jen „Strategie Zlín 100“). Změna Územního plánu statutárního města Zlína bude řešena pro celé správní území města Zlína. Změna se bude týkat vybraných částí textové a grafické části územně plánovací dokumentace v rozsahu nezbytném pro naplnění stanovených požadavků. Základní koncepce rozvoje města, stanovená platným Územním plánem statutárního města Zlína, zůstává zachována. Změna Územního plánu statutárního města Zlína se zaměří na systematické prověření a zpřesnění prostorové struktury města, a to v oblastech, kde stávající podmínky charakteru, využití a prostorového uspořádání dostatečně nepostihují specifika lineárního charakteru sídla, jeho vnitřní rozvojový potenciál, vztahy mezi urbanizovaným územím a krajinou, a nároky na rozvoj infrastruktury. Předmět veřejné zakázky vychází zejména ze schváleného Zadání změny č. 7, Strategie Zlín 100, požadavků města a schválených návrhů na změnu územního plánu. Těžiště zpracování bude spočívat zejména v řešení prostorového uspořádání města, prostorové regulace a využití odpovídajících nástrojů územního plánování, nikoliv pouze v členění území na plochy s rozdílným způsobem využití. Zpracování změny územního plánu bude vnitřně rozděleno na dílčí částí (dílčí změny, etapy), a to: I. Změna č. 7a: Změna č. 7a bude představovat dílčí změnu textové části územního plánu bez změny jeho grafické části. Předmětem zpracování budou schválené návrhy na změnu č. 7a dle přílohy zadávací dokumentace č. 1. Změna č. 7a bude zpracována jako samostatně projednatelná část změny č. 7. II. Změna č. 7b: Změna č. 7b bude představovat soubor individuálních změn textové a grafické části územního plánu, vycházející z jednotlivých návrhů na změnu Územního plánu Zlína. Předmětem zpracování budou schválené návrhy na změnu č. 7b dle přílohy zadávací dokumentace č. 1. Jednotlivé návrhy budou zpracovatelem odborně prověřeny v jejich vzájemných souvislostech a ve vazbě na celkovou koncepci rozvoje města a připravovanou změnu č. 7c. III. Změna č. 7c: Změna č. 7c bude představovat koncepční a strukturální část změny č. 7, jejímž předmětem bude komplexnější úprava způsobu prostorového uspořádání a regulace území města. Těžištěm změny č. 7c bude zejména práce s urbanistickou strukturou a charakterem jednotlivých částí města, revize způsobu funkčního členění území a posílení prostorové regulace, včetně využití specifických nástrojů územního plánování stanovených v této zadávací dokumentaci. Součástí předmětu díla a zpracování změny územního plánu bude rovněž zpracování posouzení vlivu koncepcí na životní prostředí (SEA), včetně naturového hodnocení (Natura 2000). Součástí předmětu díla je účast dodavatele jakožto zpracovatele na pracovních a koordinačních jednáních se zadavatelem (konzultace s pověřenými osobami/zastupiteli, pracovní semináře, jednání orgánů města apod.), a účast na veřejných projednáních, kde ve spolupráci se zadavatelem zajistí výklad územně plánovací dokumentace. title: Germany – Construction work – A-Bausanierung Berufliches Schulzentrum Kulmbach
description: Beschreibung: Beschreibung: Die Maßnahme umfasst die Teilsanierung des A-Baus am Berufliches Schulzentrum Kulmbach einschließlich der vollständigen Erneuerung der zentralen Wärmeversorgungsanlage für den gesamten Schulkomplex. Der 1960 errichtete Baukörper wird energetisch modernisiert, indem Fassade und Dach saniert werden. Im Inneren erfolgen umfassende bauliche und technische Erneuerungen. Die über 60 Jahre alten Heizkörper in den Klassenzimmern werden durch moderne Heizdecken ersetzt. Die Aula bleibt Veranstaltungs- und Prüfungsraum. In den Obergeschossen werden 18 Klassenzimmer mit zugehörigen Vorbereitungsräumen modernisiert. Das Untergeschoss wird künftig neben Lager- und Technikräumen auch integrierte Fachräume für Berufsvorbereitungsklassen aufnehmen.Ein zentraler Bestandteil der Maßnahme ist die Erneuerung der veralteten Heizungsanlage aus dem Jahr 1979. Geplant ist ein hybrides System aus Wärmepumpen und Gaskesseln zur Spitzenlastabdeckung, wodurch ein regenerativer Anteil von 65 % gemäß Gebäudeenergiegesetz erreicht wird. Ziel der Gesamtmaßnahme ist die bauliche, energetische und funktionale Modernisierung des Schulgebäudes sowie die langfristige Sicherstellung eines zuverlässigen und zeitgemäßen Schulbetriebs.5 Haltestellen

title: Spain – Playground climbing apparatus – Suministro e instalación de mobiliario urbano parques infantiles en Ávila
description: El objeto del presente tiene su fundamento en la necesidad de mejorar, renovar y ampliar la dotación de áreas destinadas al juego infantil y a la actividad física al aire libre existentes en distintos parques y espacios libres municipales, con el fin de garantizar unas condiciones adecuadas de seguridad, funcionalidad, accesibilidad y calidad en el uso y disfrute de estos espacios públicos. Las actuaciones previstas comprenden, por una parte, la renovación y sustitución de áreas de juego infantil existentes que han alcanzado el final de su vida útil o presentan un grado de deterioro que aconseja su reposición, así como la adecuación y modernización de sus elementos y equipamientos. Por otra parte, se contempla la implantación de nuevas áreas de juego infantil en parques y espacios libres municipales cuya actual oferta de equipamiento lúdico resulta insuficiente para atender las necesidades de la población infantil de su ámbito de influencia. La actuación pretende, asimismo, favorecer una distribución adecuada y equilibrada de los espacios de ocio y juego infantil, incrementando la disponibilidad de instalaciones destinadas al uso recreativo y al desarrollo de actividades al aire libre, y contribuyendo a la mejora de la calidad y funcionalidad de los espacios públicos municipales. Asimismo, el contrato contempla la instalación de dos nuevos parques saludables, dotados de elementos biosaludables, destinados a facilitar la práctica de ejercicio físico al aire libre y a fomentar hábitos de vida activos y saludables entre la ciudadanía. Estos espacios estarán especialmente orientados a la población adulta y senior, proporcionando equipamientos adecuados para la realización de ejercicios de movilidad, mantenimiento físico y mejora de la condición física.

description: Die Regionaltangente West (RTW) ist eine neue tangentiale Schienenverbindung im Rhein-Main-Gebiet zur Verbesserung des öffentlichen Schienenpersonennahverkehrs im Ballungsraum Frankfurt am Main. Sie dient in erster Linie der besseren Verbindung der westlichen Stadtteile der Stadt Frankfurt am Main sowie der umliegenden Kreise, Städte und Gemeinden miteinander und untereinander und der besseren Anbindung an den Frankfurter Flughafen. Das Projekt ist in die Planfeststellungsabschnitte PFA Nord, PFA Mitte sowie die PFA Süd I und Süd II aufgeteilt. Die hier gegenständliche Ausschreibung liegt im Planfeststellungsabschnitt Süd 1. Der Planfeststellungsbeschluss Süd 1 liegt den Verdingungsunterlagen bei und ist bei der Bauausführung zu beachten. Gegenstand der vorliegenden Ausschreibung sind folgende Leistungen: Herstellung eines ein- und zweigleisigen Streckenoberbau nach EBO im Bereich Mörfelder Landstraße bis Bf Neu-Isenburg (km 0,1+00 bis km 3,8+37) im Planfeststellungsabschnitt Süd 1, sowie die erforderlichen infrastrukturellen Anbindungen an die Bestandsinfrastruktur der Strecken 3650, 35651 und 3688 der DB InfraGO AG. Die gegenständlichen Maßnahmen beinhalten sowohl der ein- und zweigleisigen Streckenabschnitte der Anbindungen an die Bestandsinfrastruktur der DB InfraGO AG, als auch alle hierfür durch den AN zu erbringenden bauvorbereitenden Zusammenhangsarbeiten (z.B. technische Bearbeitung, Leitungsumlegungs-/sicherungsmaßnahmen, Gründungsarbeiten, Einbau Weichen und Weichenheizungsanlagen, Kabeltiefbauarbeiten und -verlegung, Kampfmittelsondierungsleistungen, Sicherungsleistungen etc.). Eine detaillierte Beschreibung der zu erbringenden Leistungen kann den Vergabeunterlagen entnommen werden.
